node.title: Must have CLI of Perl's sed's n command
node.author: abdan
node.doctext:
How do we have CLI of Perl's sed's n command ?
e.g. illustration:

cat script.txt| perl -nle 'if (/^===\w+\s*$/){ next # ??? how to ignore first $_, here eg. ===Hello, to directly become replaced by next line ; # ... } print'
